title: Nine Years of Interviewing
subtitle: 名人与明星 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 名人与明星（文学艺术与体育·影视与名人）
meta: 主题语境：名人与明星（文学艺术与体育·影视与名人）　|　核心词汇：celebrity　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 celebrity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my mother was sent to interview ① celebrity she could not name, and she said the interviewing was the whole of the lesson. The ② celebrity, meaning the person and not the fame, was nine years late and was interviewed by whoever came last; celebrity, she said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ celebrity in that room had the same answer, and the ④ celebrity at the end, meaning the one the photographers kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever interviewed properly. Celebrity, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ celebrity was the whole of the century, meaning the fame it carried and not the person. The ⑥ celebrity, meaning the fame and not any of that, is the only thing in a century that everybody watches and nobody questions; celebrity, he said, is either something you interview or the only word that means both a person and a fame. She said the fame is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ celebrity had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the answer. The ⑧ celebrity of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years and eleven years of interviewing; celebrity, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ celebrity I remember is the one at the end, which was interviewed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ celebrity, my grandmother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being interviewed; every celebrity, she said, is a fame that has agreed to look like a person. She said the fame was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 名人（指那个人本身，与那份名气相对）
C. 固定搭配：interview a celebrity 采访一位名人
D. n. 名人（指房间里每一位）
E. n. 名人（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 名气（抽象：它带着的那份声誉）
G. n. 那份名气（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The celebrity, meaning the person and not the fame
celebrity was the whole of the century
the celebrity had become a number in a report
The celebrity of the whole thing
A celebrity, my grandmother said in 1984

answers.why: interview a celebrity 意为“采访一位名人”，1962 年母亲被派去采访她叫不出名字的那位名人。
celebrity 意为“名人、明星”，指那个人本身而不是那份名气，晚了九年，由最后来的人采访。
celebrity 指房间里每一位名人，每一位都是同样的回答。
celebrity 指末尾那一位（摄影师留下的一位），是唯一有人认真采访过的。
celebrity 意为“名气”，抽象指它带着的那份声誉，父亲说 celebrity 就是那个世纪的全部。
celebrity 为抽象用法，指那份名气本身，是一个世纪里人人都看、却没人质疑的东西。
celebrity 意为“名人、明星”，到 1974 年这位 celebrity 成了报告里的一个数字。
celebrity 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年与十一年的采访。
celebrity 意为“名人”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1979 年接受采访，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
celebrity 为抽象总称，祖母说一位名人是唯一会因为被认真采访而变好的东西。
